name: Renato Gallina
label: Character
description: In Stormwind's Trade District, Renato Gallina calls travelers toward his family's winery.
intro: In Stormwind's Trade District, Renato Gallina calls travelers toward his family's winery.

p: Renato Gallina calls to passers-by among the Trade District stalls, proclaiming his family's vintages the finest in Stormwind. The Gallina family runs a winery along the Canals, and Renato promotes it with pamphlets. Travelers can bring one to his sister Suzetta at the shop for a free bottle of wine.
